title: Rate limiter
prompt: Design a rate limiter that protects a public API from clients who send too many requests.
key_points: Chose an algorithm (token bucket, or a sliding window for strict quotas) and explained how it works
Made check-and-decrement atomic across servers (for example one script in the shared store), avoiding the read-modify-write race
Sized state and throughput with numbers (bytes per key, shards needed)
Decided fail-open vs fail-closed per kind of limit when the store is down
Handled hot keys and added latency (local pre-limiter, edge limits), or traded exactness for less central load
Rejected with 429, Retry-After and rate-limit headers; rules change without a redeploy
